profile.reading: Names are brand plus type plus model code plus key specs, word order varies. Sizes are cable lengths in M, screen sizes in inch with " , power in W/V/A, capacity in MAH/GB/TB, memory as RAM/storage like 12/256GB or 8+16/256GB, tip sizes like 4.5*3.0. Packs are not carton counts, codes like BW29 BG3 KSC-467 SK427 identify the exact reference. Two products of one brand differ by model code, memory mem token, length/power/capacity number+unit, connector TYPE-C/LIGHTING/MICRO, or quality ORIGINAL/COPY.
